summary: Nomura Holdings filed Form 6-K to report its first-quarter financial results for the period ending June 30, 2026. The filing details net revenue of ¥686.7 billion, pretax income of ¥211.5 billion, and net income of ¥145.6 billion, with ROE at 15.4%. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change—is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer and does not constitute a special situation.
